description: We are a multidisciplinary team from Bahrain’s Nasser Scientific and Technical Center (NCST), proudly participating in the NASA challenge. Passionate about space exploration, software development, AI, and data analysis, we aim to transform complex lunar mission challenges into innovative solutions. Through Lunar Landing Site Navigator, we strive to make Moon landing site analysis more accessible, intuitive, and efficient, contributing to the future of space exploration through teamwork, creativity, and determination.
